title: Better API or GuardRails for Distributed Optimizations with non-SPMD graphs

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

body:
## 🐛 Describe the bug

Flipping `torch._inductor.config.bucket_all_gathers_fx` to `"only_fsdp"` causes a deadlock when a `torch.compile(fullgraph=True)` model wrapped by SimpleFSDP broadcasts an FSDP-managed parameter inside the compiled graph (e.g. adding a `[1,1,H]` start token to a `[B,T,H]` activation). The run stalls before completing the first iteration.

Minimal repro script: https://gist.github.com/zaptrem/c28fa08e618e489ed3d85a2988804225

### Minimal Reproduction
```
TORCH_LOGS=recompiles,cudagraphs \
/home/ubuntu/.local/bin/poetry run python -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=2 --rdzv-id=mini3 --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  minimal_single_file_fsdp_bucket_repro.py
```

Important bits in `minimal_single_file_fsdp_bucket_repro.py`:
- Inlined the pieces of `pytorch_thunder.simple_fsdp` needed to mirror our production setup: DTensor-based parameter redistribution, selective activation checkpointing via `context_fn`, etc.
- Defines a tiny MLP with a learnable `start_token` parameter shaped `[1,1,D]` and adds it to the activations (`x = x + self.start_token`). That single broadcast is enough to trigger the hang.
- After wrapping with `data_parallel` and compiling (`torch.compile(..., fullgraph=True, dynamic=False)`), running with `bucket_all_gathers_fx="only_fsdp"` freezes after Inductor records the first cudagraph; processes are killed after the 120 s timeout.

### Expected vs. Actual
- **Expected:** The three training steps complete and exit normally (as they do when the config uses the default bucket settings).
- **Actual:** Execution hangs after the first iteration; no parameter updates finish before TorchElastic terminates the workers.

### Additional Notes
- Removing the problematic broadcast (`x = x + self.start_token`) or leaving `bucket_all_gathers_fx` at its default lets the script finish in seconds.
- The repo bundles PyTorch built from current main; GPUs are NVIDIA H100s.


### Error logs

NCCL timeout
